what_it_is.prose: CSL is India's largest public-sector shipyard and the only Indian shipyard to have built an aircraft carrier — the Indigenous Aircraft Carrier (IAC-1) INS Vikrant (45,000 t deep displacement), delivered to the Indian Navy on 28 Jul 2022 and commissioned 2 Sep 2022. CSL is also building 8 Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW-SWC) for the Indian Navy (lead ship INS Mahe delivered Oct 24, 2025). CSL constructs and repairs commercial vessels, offshore vessels, and export ships. The yard has secured multiple export orders including for European clients.
